before_freeze_allowed: actual prior user message quoted for topic
general knowledge and independent visual reasoning

concept: Rainy midday freight-yard service-room field observation and contemporaneous record; visible wired radio apparatus.
requester_owned: independent scene selection and actual generation

required_components: human observer oriented to one outside vehicle
lens physically aimed toward that vehicle
same vehicle marker identifiable in an in-frame camera capture or notebook photo
pixel_criteria.failure: A generic camera or train-yard costume without a visible target-to-record correspondence fails; partial correspondence does not pass.

required_components: pencil tip at an open observation record
record related to the same outside target
pixel_criteria.failure: A floating tool, blank unrelated book or contact hidden from view fails.

required_components: wire visibly connected or continuously traceable to radio on same observer
pixel_criteria.failure: Disconnected loose cable or unrelated radio possession is insufficient. Actual speech, message meaning and receipt remain unobservable.

required_components: directly attached portrait in native image call
face visually guided by reference at assessable scale
pixel_criteria.failure: Text-only mention, generic face at unassessable scale or incompatible hair is insufficient; exact real identity is not a pixel claim.

required_components: two owned hands with coherent tools and target contact
camera lens route and outdoor subject not contradictory
pixel_criteria.failure: Missing hand, merged tools, impossible cable or occluded required contact fails.

qualification: Every listed compound criterion requires all components to be visible together. partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. Genre impression, native call, audits and user acceptance remain separate.
